title: fix(release): revert the red 18.1.0 version commit and fix the dogfood proof that reddened it
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

**Release fix for 18.1.0.** The maintainer chose to revert the version commit and re-cut 18.1.0. This pull is the one landing the merge freeze lets through.

## What happened

- #24876 merged as `74fa3cb6d` at 04:58Z. Its release run (40064441171) was refused by `Full battery green at the version commit`. The reason: the newest full-battery run at or before it, the 04:01Z hourly run 40060651935 on `a57643d3d`, concluded `failure`.
- The red is one dogfood test. `showcase-d3-d4-capabilities.dogfood.test.ts` ("[#9237] the grant the rule reconciles is one the gates CONSULT") still matched the pre-#25549 sentence `'showcase_project' is not under record-sharing enforcement`. #25591 (#25549) changed `SharingService.inertGrantReason` on purpose: on a public object a share row is now consulted for an external member of the record's organization. The refusal therefore names the recipient's standing: "has a public sharing model, so a share row on it is consulted only for an external member of the record's organization, and that organization could not be resolved".
- Dogfood runs on main's push, hourly and dispatch runs only, never in the merge queue, so the red first showed on `main`. The push and 05:00Z hourly runs on `74fa3cb6d` itself fail the same way.
- The release gate never reads a run after the version commit, so no re-run and no later fix can turn `74fa3cb6d` green. A new version commit is needed.

## The diff

1. `test(dogfood)`: the contrast now matches the public-OWD sentence #25549 writes, up to "consulted only for an external member". The object and the code stay asserted, and a comment records why the wording moved. Locally, `vitest run test/showcase-d3-d4-capabilities.dogfood.test.ts` in `packages/qa/dogfood` gives 5 passed (5).
2. `Revert "chore: version packages (#24876)"`: a plain `git revert 74fa3cb6d` with no conflicts. Every package version goes back to 18.0.0, and the 265 changesets it consumed come back.
   - These include five that landed after the Version Packages PR was generated and so were not in its changelog: #25591 (#25549, `minor`, semantic), #25592, #25596 and two patches. Their code is in `74fa3cb6d`'s tree.
   - Once this lands, the refreshed Version Packages PR versions 18.1.0 again, with a changelog that names everything that ships.

Nothing was published. `npm view @objectstack/cli version` still answers 18.0.0, and no 18.1.0 tag or GitHub Release exists.

## After it lands

- The fleet relay's refresh stroke (`release.yml`, `refresh_version_pr: true`) regenerates the Version Packages PR.
- The maintainer approves its checks and merges it, then approves the `release` deployment once `Full battery green at the version commit` reads the new version commit green.

## Out of scope

No product code, `content/docs/releases/`, or workflow changes. The 18.1 release page (#25460, #25553, #25590) already describes 18.1.0.
